svg.title: Inbox at nil: clear every list, then celebrate
svg.desc: When every list is empty, Nilbox throws a party: confetti, the heading inbox == nil, an Achievement unlocked chip for a 7-day streak, and a terminal that runs nilbox status and checks off each list (review requested 0, clear; yours 0, clear; snoozed 3, they'll be back; dismissed 18, rest in peace; streak 7, days running, a new best) before a playful panic, goroutine 1 vibing, Developer.TouchGrass, and exit status 0. Beside it, the achievements you can unlock and the replay button, go run ./party.

g.text: Empty every list and the inbox throws a party:
confetti, a terminal that checks off each list,
and achievements to unlock along the way.
With Reduce motion on, it all holds still.
Zero items. Zero notifications. Zero regrets.
panic: runtime error: nothing left to do
